subject: Anglais
title: Anglais · 2de · Grammaire · Infinitif, gérondif et connecteurs
description: Règles et automatismes — infinitif, gérondif et connecteurs.

cards.front: Traduis : « afin de réduire les déchets ».
Complète : The match was cancelled ___ the rain.
cards.back: The match was cancelled because of the rain.

cards.front: Relie avec therefore : It was unsafe. They closed it.
cards.back: It was unsafe; therefore, they closed it.

cards.front: Relie avec however : It is costly. It is effective.
cards.back: It is costly; however, it is effective.

cards.front: Relie : One source agrees. The other disagrees.
cards.back: One source agrees, whereas the other disagrees.
